verdict.rationale: Conductor documents an API and a hosted MCP server, but both are scoped to managing cloud workspaces. The documented operations are creating workspaces, sending prompts to the agent and reading its replies, which is well short of UI parity. Much of the UI surface has no programmatic evidence, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: API coverage of local worktree workspaces, reassign/follow/collaboration actions, routines, settings and port forwarding, checkpoints/revert, diff review and PR merge/archive, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation of API breadth.
